# TDK CLI

> Kubernetes-free microservice development. Run your whole service landscape locally without learning Kubernetes (a {{ site.data.tdk.scale_plain }}-service fixture boots on a clean CI runner in about {{ site.data.tdk.erp_boot_minutes }} minutes) — one service.json generates {{ site.data.tdk.files_per_service }} files per service.

TDK is a manifest-driven CLI built on Tilt and Starlark. Write one `service.json` per service and TDK generates Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, Vite/TypeScript config (React or Vue 3 frontends), Traefik, Postgres, NATS JetStream wiring, Prisma, and other stack-wide artifacts from it — running on plain Docker, no Kubernetes cluster required. The free tier needs no license key and costs nothing, ever.

## Getting Started

Fastest binary install (macOS/Linux, picks the right binary for your arch):

```
curl -fsSL https://tdk-landscape.github.io/install.sh | sh
tdk doctor
tdk project example
cd tdk-example
tdk up
```

Also installable via npm, npx, pnpm, or bun — see [Quick Start]({{ '/docs/quickstart/' | absolute_url }}) for every option.

### Native Windows 10/11 (AMD64)

Use Docker Desktop in Linux container mode and install [Tilt for Windows](https://docs.tilt.dev/install.html). The native Windows CLI and Windows smoke CI are merged, but the public Windows executable and real Windows 11 acceptance run are still pending. Once the latest release includes `tdk-windows-amd64.exe`, install it from PowerShell with:

```
irm https://tdk-landscape.github.io/install.ps1 | iex
```

Then open a new PowerShell window and run `tdk --version`, `tdk doctor`, `tdk project example`, and `tdk up`. WSL2 Ubuntu works as Linux. See [Windows Quick Start]({{ '/docs/quickstart/' | absolute_url }}#windows-setup) for port, DNS, and Docker file-sharing guidance.

GitHub releases: https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-releases/releases/latest

## Docs

- [Quick Start]({{ '/docs/quickstart/' | absolute_url }}): install, verify, and boot a working stack in minutes
- [Configuration]({{ '/docs/configuration/' | absolute_url }}): service.json reference — appType, featuresEnabled, required package.json scripts
- [Examples]({{ '/docs/examples/' | absolute_url }}): reference landscapes — minimal PSR starter, SaaS starter, restaurant ops, a {{ site.data.tdk.erp_services }}-service scale fixture across {{ site.data.tdk.erp_domains }} ERP-style domains (generated services answering /health, not a business app)
- [Scripts]({{ '/docs/scripts/' | absolute_url }}): package.json scripts required per appType, enforced by `tdk doctor`
- [Install and connect the TDK MCP server](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/agent-tooling/tdk-mcp-setup.md): install TDK with npm or the prebuilt binary, configure Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Cursor to launch the local stdio server, and run `doctor` then `up` for the first time
- [TDK MCP tool reference](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/agent-tooling/tdk-mcp.md): the tools a connected client exposes (`doctor`, `up`, `down`, `status`, `logs`, `resource_list`) and how to target a project

- [AI Agents & Skills]({{ '/docs/agents/' | absolute_url }}): install the portable TDK agent skills (Agent Skills `SKILL.md` format) for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor, and the `AGENTS.md` rules template for other tools

## Contributing Back

- When an AI agent using the TDK CLI or TDK MCP server hits a problem in the framework, it should open an issue and, when it has a fix, a pull request against [tdk-cli-core](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-core). Report the reproduction, the tdk version, and the expected behavior.
- Example: [tdk-cli-core#1204](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-core/issues/1204), `tdk project` output under `.tdk/.tdk-out` is picked up by Vitest in Node/TypeScript projects.

## Agent Skills

Portable Agent Skills live in [tdk-skills](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-skills). Install with `npx skills add tdk-landscape/tdk-skills`.

Full machine-readable index: [tdk-skills llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-skills/main/llms.txt).

Current skills include:
- tdk-doctor — check or repair the environment and project config before `tdk up`
- tdk-troubleshoot — diagnose a failed `tdk up`, Docker or Tilt session
- layer-autoresearch — contributor experiment loop for the L1-L4 Docker layers
- tdk-scaffold — scaffold new backends, frontends, agents and MCP servers
- tdk-generated-files — understand and manage `.autogenerated/` files and drift
- tdk-agents — run AI agents + MCP tools + database in one local stack
- tdk-data — reset, seed and snapshot local Postgres data
- tdk-benchmark — measure container scale, idle memory and start times
- tdk-ports — port selection, Traefik routing and localhost URLs
- tdk-upgrade — upgrade the CLI and handle generated-file drift
- tdk-byo — bring-your-own resources and existing services
- tdk-secrets — project `.env`, params and secrets
- tdk-layout — multi-repo layouts and ownership patterns
- tdk-helm — use TDK locally alongside Helm for production
- tdk-frontend — frontend scaffolding and generated Vite/nginx configs
- tdk-python — Python backend services
- tdk-ui — interactive terminal dashboard (`tdk ui`)
- tdk-dry-run — preview stacks with `tdk up --dry-run`
- tdk-service-json — edit and validate the service.json contract
- tdk-networks — inspect routed URLs and stack topology
- tdk-doctor-verbose — deep diagnostic runs with extra verbosity
- tdk-contributing — guide for contributors working on tdk-cli-core

## Reference Landscapes (GitHub)

- [tdk-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-example): minimal PSR stack (Hono, Vite, Bun)
- [tdk-user-management](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-user-management): enterprise SCIM 2.0 & OAuth2 PKCE demo
- [tdk-restaurant-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-restaurant-example): restaurant operations demo — reservations, kitchen, menu, floor ops
- [tdk-erp-system](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-erp-system): {{ site.data.tdk.erp_services }}-service scale fixture across {{ site.data.tdk.erp_domains }} ERP-style domains; all healthy on a clean CI runner in {{ site.data.tdk.erp_boot_seconds }} s, images built ({{ site.data.tdk.erp_ci_run }})
- [tdk-ecommerce-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-ecommerce-example): Vue 3 storefront + Hono catalog API; smallest example of `--framework vue`
- [tdk-auth-queue-email-example](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-auth-queue-email-example): run an OIDC identity provider, a NATS queue and email (Mailpit) locally behind small interfaces
- [tdk-saas-starter](https://github.com/tdk-landscape/tdk-saas-starter): SaaS dashboard + checkout starter

## Licensing

Free needs no license key and costs nothing, ever — `tdk up` runs with zero setup. Premium unlocks the Verdaccio private registry, DDD scaffolding, and other paid extras, up to {{ site.data.tdk.premium_project_limit }} project IDs per key. Enterprise adds SSO, air-gapped, and SLA options.

- [Request a license]({{ '/#waitlist' | absolute_url }})
